title: Latitude® SignalMaster Rear-Facing Directional Warning
subtitle: Ultra-slim rear-facing directional warning integrated into your light bar in 6-head and 8-head lengths, Amber only.
description: The Federal Signal Latitude® SignalMaster delivers an ultra-slim, rear-facing directional warning arrow integrated directly into the rear of your light bar. Available in 6-head and 8-head Amber-only configurations for police, fire, and work-truck applications.
summary_bullets: Directional warning stick light with Latitude® styling
Available in Amber, Blue, Red, and White

features: Ultra-slim profile integrated into the rear of the light bar
Low-profile design for a clean rear appearance
Integrates with existing light bar controller
benefits: Adds directional warning without increasing the light bar's rear footprint
Dead-end-prevention filter logic — only valid SKU combos enabled
applications: Municipal police patrol — sedan and SUV platforms
Fire/EMS apparatus — rear traffic direction at scene
Work-truck and utility fleets — traffic control around work zones

specifications.profile: Ultra-slim, integrated into light bar rear

shopify._model: ONE Shopify product with multiple variants. SL#S-A SKUs = Shopify variant SKUs.
shopify._note: SL8S-A48 and SL8S-A-50 (and combined SL8S-A48-50) all share the 8-head/Amber configuration; the 48/50 suffixes are mount- and harness-variant packaging not yet confirmed against install docs, so they are mapped to the same Length/Color combination pending confirmation. Z8573327A does not follow the SL#S-A SKU convention and is not confirmed to be a head-count variant, so it is listed under commerce.accessories rather than the Length/Color grid — Needs Review before assigning an attribute mapping.
